_comment: Error codes for API responses - English version
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please login again.
SESSION_REPLACED: Your account was signed in on another device. Please login again.
REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID: Refresh token is invalid, expired, or revoked. Please login again.
USER_NOT_FOUND_OR_INACTIVE: User account is inactive or not found
TOKEN_INVALIDATED_PASSWORD_CHANGED: Your password was changed. Please login again.
TOKEN_INVALIDATED_PERMISSIONS_CHANGED: Your permissions were changed. Please login again.
GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_NOT_LINKED: This account was created with email and password. Sign in with email and password, or contact support to link Google.
GOOGLE_TOKEN_INVALID: Google sign-in failed or expired. Please try again.
GOOGLE_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google sign-in is not configured on the server.
DATABASE_ERROR: Could not save your changes. Please try again.
SUBSCRIPTION_PAST_DUE: Your subscription payment is past due. Please update your payment method.
NO_SUBSCRIPTION: No active subscription found. Please subscribe to continue.
SUBSCRIPTION_PERIOD_ENDED: Your subscription period has ended. Please renew to continue.
SUBSCRIPTION_PERIOD_MISSING: Subscription period end date is missing. Please contact support.
ORDER_SCHEDULE_CONFLICT: This shop does not allow overlapping rentals. Change the dates, lower the quantity, or remove items that are fully booked.
INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
GATEWAY_ERROR: The service is busy right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH: Password must be at least 6 characters
PASSWORD_RESET_LINK_SENT: If an account with that email exists, a password reset link has been sent
PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_USED: Password reset token has already been used
EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Email has not been verified. Please check your email and verify your account before logging in.
CROSS_MERCHANT_ACCESS_DENIED: Cannot access data from other merchants
MERCHANT_ASSOCIATION_REQUIRED: User must be associated with a merchant
NO_MERCHANT_ACCESS: User does not have merchant access
NO_OUTLET_ACCESS: User does not have outlet access
DELETE_USER_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Cannot delete user outside your scope
UPDATE_USER_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Cannot update user outside your scope
MERCHANT_TRANSFER_ADMIN_ONLY: Only a system administrator can move an account to another merchant
MERCHANT_OWNER_TRANSFER_NOT_SUPPORTED: A merchant owner account cannot be moved to another merchant
OUTLET_ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED: Choose an outlet that belongs to the selected merchant
OUTLET_MERCHANT_MISMATCH: The selected outlet does not belong to the selected merchant
CANNOT_TRANSFER_LAST_MERCHANT_OWNER: Assign another active merchant owner before changing this account
DELETE_OWN_ACCOUNT_ONLY: You can only delete your own account
RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
OUTLET_NAME_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: Outlet name and address are required
INVALID_END_DATE: End date must be in the future
ADMIN_OUTLET_ID_REQUIRED: Admin users need to specify outlet ID
INVALID_CURRENCY: Invalid currency code. Supported currencies: USD, VND
OUTLET_REQUIRED: Choose an outlet, or set a default outlet for your shop.
MULTIPLE_ENTITIES_FOUND: Multiple entities found with same identifier
INVALID_TIMEZONE: Unknown time zone. Pick a zone from the list (for example Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).
TENANT_KEY_ALREADY_EXISTS: This store URL key is already taken. Please choose a different one.
MISSING_ENDPOINT_OR_TOKEN: Missing endpoint or token in request
PAYMENT_METHOD_AND_TRANSACTION_ID_REQUIR: Payment method and transaction ID are required
NO_SUBSCRIPTION_FOUND: No subscription found for this merchant
FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: This feature is not yet implemented
NO_DATA_AVAILABLE: No data available - user not assigned to merchant/outlet
NO_DEFAULT_OUTLET: No default outlet found for merchant
PRODUCT_OUTLET_NOT_FOUND: Product not found in specified outlet
CUSTOMER_DUPLICATE: A customer with this email or phone already exists
OUTLET_NAME_EXISTS: An outlet with this name already exists for this merchant
CATEGORY_NAME_EXISTS: Category with this name already exists
PRODUCT_NAME_EXISTS: A product with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.
STOCK_BELOW_RENTED: Stock cannot be lower than the number of units currently rented out.
PLAN_NAME_EXISTS: A plan with this name already exists
MERCHANT_DUPLICATE: A merchant with this email or phone already exists. Please use a different email or phone number.
CANNOT_DELETE_DEFAULT_OUTLET: Cannot delete the default outlet. This is the main outlet created during registration and must remain active.
CANNOT_DELETE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY: Cannot delete the default "General" category. This category was created during registration and must remain active.
CUSTOMER_HAS_ACTIVE_ORDERS: Cannot delete customer with active orders. Please complete or cancel these orders first.
PLAN_HAS_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTIONS: Cannot delete plan with active subscriptions. Please wait for subscriptions to expire or cancel them first.
MERCHANT_HAS_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION: Cannot delete merchant with active subscription. Please cancel the subscription first.
CANNOT_DELETE_SELF: You cannot delete your own account. Please contact another administrator.
CANNOT_DELETE_LAST_ADMIN: Cannot delete the last administrator. Please assign another administrator first.
PRODUCT_NO_STOCK_ENTRY: Product must have at least one outlet stock entry
CANNOT_DETECT_ENTITY: Cannot detect entity type from data
ORDER_PAYMENT_REQUIRED: Order ID, amount, and method are required
SUBSCRIPTION_END_DATE_REQUIRED: Subscription ID, end date, and amount are required
DEVICE_INFO_REQUIRED: Missing required fields: deviceId, pushToken, platform
MERCHANT_CREATED_SUCCESS: Merchant created successfully with default outlet
MERCHANT_REGISTERED_TRIAL_SUCCESS: Merchant registered successfully with 14-day free trial
MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_CREATED_SUCCESS: Merchant account created successfully with default outlet and trial subscription
MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_CREATED_PENDING_VERIFIC: Merchant account created successfully. Please verify your email to activate your account
USER_ACCOUNT_CREATED_PENDING_VERIFICATIO: User account created successfully. Please verify your email to activate your account
CHECK_AUDIT_LOG_FAILED: Failed to check audit log completeness
CHECK_ORPHANED_RECORDS_FAILED: Failed to check for orphaned records
CHECK_PRODUCT_STOCK_FAILED: Failed to check product stock consistency
RECENT_OPERATIONS_WITHOUT_LOGS: Recent operations found without corresponding audit logs
ALL_ORDERS_VALID_AMOUNTS: All non-cancelled orders have valid amounts
ALL_ORDER_ITEMS_VALID_PRODUCTS: All order items have valid product references
ALL_ORDERS_VALID_CUSTOMERS: All orders have valid customer references
ALL_PAYMENTS_VALID_ORDERS: All payments have valid order references
ALL_PRODUCTS_VALID_STOCK: All products have consistent available stock calculations
ALL_PRODUCTS_VALID_LEVELS: All products have valid stock levels
ALL_USERS_VALID_OUTLETS: All users have valid outlet assignments
AUDIT_LOG_WORKING: Audit logging appears to be working correctly
MULTIPLE_ENTITIES_IN_FILE: Multiple entity types found in file
AWS_S3_TEST_FAILED: Could not check file storage. Please try again.
PRODUCT_HAS_OPEN_ORDERS: This product is on an order that is reserved or being rented. Finish or cancel those orders before deleting it.
SEARCH_FAILED: We couldn't search by image right now. Please try again in a moment, or use text search.
SEARCH_TIMEOUT: The image search took too long. Please try again in a few minutes.
IMAGE_SEARCH_RATE_LIMITED: Too many image searches. Please try again in a few minutes.
INVALID_MIN_SIMILARITY: Invalid minimum similarity (must be between 0 and 1)
ROLE_NOT_AVAILABLE: This role cannot be assigned yet
PLATFORM_ACCESS_DENIED: Your plan does not include access from this device. Please upgrade your plan or use another device.
PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED: This feature is not included in your plan. Please upgrade to use it.
SCOPE_VIOLATION: Access denied: you cannot access data of another shop.
AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Authentication failed. Please sign in again.
TOKEN_INVALIDATED: Your session has ended because the password was changed. Please sign in again.
USER_INFO_NOT_FOUND: User information was not found in the request.
SUBSCRIPTION_CHECK_FAILED: Could not verify your subscription. Please try again.
SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_FAILED: Could not cancel the subscription. Please try again.
SUBSCRIPTION_CANNOT_RESUME: Only a cancelled or paused subscription can be resumed.
SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRY_REMINDERS_PARTIAL_FA: Some expiry reminder emails could not be sent.
CANNOT_DELETE_ADDON_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This add-on cannot be deleted because your current usage would exceed the limit.
ADDON_OUTLETS_NEED_MULTI_BRANCH_PLAN: Only a multi-branch plan (Enterprise) can take a branch add-on.
ADDON_PRICE_NOT_ON_SALE: This add-on is paused and cannot be sold.
ADDON_FEATURE_ALREADY_ON: This shop already has this feature. Undo the turn-off instead of adding it again.
ADDON_FEATURE_IN_PLAN: This shop's plan already includes this feature. No add-on is needed.
ADDON_PRICE_IN_USE: Shops use this add-on: its pack size cannot change. Add a new row instead.
PLAN_CHANGE_REMOVE_OUTLET_ADDONS: This shop still has branch add-ons. Remove the branch add-ons first, then switch to a plan without multiple branches.
PRICED_ADDON_READ_ONLY: A priced add-on is changed from the shop's Add-on tab.
LEMON_SQUEEZY_NOT_CONFIGURED: Online payment is not set up yet. Please contact support.
LEMON_SQUEEZY_CHECKOUT_URL_MISSING: The payment link is missing. Please try again or contact support.
LEMON_SQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The payment notification signature is invalid.
STRIPE_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED: The payment notification signature is required.
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_NOT_SET: The payment notification secret is not set.
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The payment notification signature is invalid.
SEPAY_NOT_CONFIGURED: Bank transfer payment is not set up yet. Please contact support.
PLAN_LEMON_SQUEEZY_VARIANT_NOT_SET: This plan is not linked to online payment yet.
PLAN_STRIPE_PRICE_ID_NOT_SET: This plan has no payment price set yet.
SUCCESS_URL_REQUIRED: The success return address is required.
CANCEL_URL_REQUIRED: The cancel return address is required.
EMAIL_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: The email service is not set up.
INVALID_EXTENSION_DURATION: The extension period is not valid.
NEW_END_DATE_REQUIRED: Please choose the new end date.
CANNOT_CREATE_ORDER_FOR_OTHER_MERCHANT: You cannot create an order for a branch of another shop.
CANNOT_CREATE_ORDER_FOR_OTHER_OUTLET: You can only create orders for your own branch.
CANNOT_CREATE_PRODUCT_AT_OTHER_OUTLET: You can only add products to your own branch.
CANNOT_UPDATE_ORDER_FROM_OTHER_MERCHANT: You cannot update an order of another shop.
CANNOT_UPDATE_ORDER_FROM_OTHER_OUTLET: You can only update orders of your own branch.
CANNOT_DELETE_ORDER_FROM_OTHER_MERCHANT: You cannot delete an order of another shop.
CANNOT_DELETE_ORDER_FROM_OTHER_OUTLET: You can only delete orders of your own branch.
CANNOT_RESTORE_ORDER_FROM_OTHER_MERCHANT: You cannot restore an order of another shop.
CANNOT_RESTORE_ORDER_FROM_OTHER_OUTLET: You can only restore orders of your own branch.
CANNOT_DELETE_NON_CANCELLED_ORDER: Only cancelled orders can be deleted. Please cancel the order first.
ORDER_PAYMENT_INVALID: The payment for this order is not valid.
REDEEM_EXCEEDS_TOTAL: The loyalty points used are worth more than the order total.
SOME_ORDERS_NOT_FOUND: Some of the selected orders were not found.
UNAUTHORIZED_TO_DELETE_SOME_ORDERS: You are not allowed to delete some of the selected orders.
NO_CALENDAR_DATA: No calendar data for this period.
NOTES_IMAGES_UPLOAD_FAILED: Could not upload the note photos. Please try again.
PICKUP_NOTES_IMAGES_UPLOAD_FAILED: Could not upload the hand-over photos. Please try again.
RETURN_NOTES_IMAGES_UPLOAD_FAILED: Could not upload the return photos. Please try again.
DAMAGE_NOTES_IMAGES_UPLOAD_FAILED: Could not upload the damage photos. Please try again.
PRODUCT_NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_OUTLET: This product is not available at this branch.
PRODUCT_HAS_NO_IMAGES: Add at least one product photo before syncing image search.
UNAUTHORIZED_TO_DELETE_SOME_PRODUCTS: You are not allowed to delete some of the selected products.
CUSTOMERS_HAVE_ACTIVE_ORDERS: Some customers still have active orders. Please complete or cancel those orders first.
UNAUTHORIZED_TO_DELETE_SOME_CUSTOMERS: You are not allowed to delete some of the selected customers.
INVALID_CUSTOMER_ID: The customer ID is not valid.
INVALID_CATEGORY_ID_FORMAT: The category ID is not valid.
INVALID_OUTLET_ID_FORMAT: The branch ID is not valid.
USER_ALREADY_DELETED: This user has already been deleted.
USER_NOT_DELETED: This user is not deleted, so it cannot be restored.
INVALID_USER_OUTLET_ASSIGNMENTS: Some users are assigned to a branch that does not exist.
IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image is too large. Please choose a smaller photo.
LOYALTY_PROGRAM_INACTIVE: The loyalty program is turned off.
LOYALTY_PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND: The loyalty program was not found.
LOYALTY_TIER_NOT_FOUND: The loyalty tier was not found.
CANNOT_DELETE_LAST_TIER: The last tier cannot be deleted.
INVALID_TIER_ID: The tier ID is not valid.
POST_SLUG_EXISTS: A post with this address already exists.
INVALID_POST_ID_FORMAT: The post ID is not valid.
INVALID_TAG_ID_FORMAT: The tag ID is not valid.
INVALID_KEYS: You can only delete files from the blog media folder.
AUDIT_LOG_ID_REQUIRED: The audit log ID is required.
AUDIT_LOG_MISSING: Some recent operations have no audit log.
INVALID_AUDIT_LOG_DETAILS: The audit log details are not valid.
NO_OLD_VALUES_IN_LOG: The log has no previous values to restore.
NO_SAFE_FIELDS_TO_REVERT: There are no fields that can be safely reverted.
REVERT_ONLY_FOR_UPDATE: Only an update can be reverted.
BATCH_DELETE_FAILED: Could not delete the selected items. Please try again.
STATS_FETCH_FAILED: Could not load the statistics. Please try again.
VOLUME_CHECK_FAILED: Could not check the storage. Please try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
INCONSISTENT_STOCK_DETECTED: Some products have inconsistent stock numbers.
ORPHANED_ORDER_ITEMS_DETECTED: Some order items belong to no order.
INVALID_ORDER_CUSTOMER_REFS: Some orders point to a customer that does not exist.
INVALID_ORDER_ITEM_PRODUCT_REFS: Some order items point to a product that does not exist.
INVALID_PAYMENT_ORDER_REFS: Some payments point to an order that does not exist.
ZERO_AMOUNT_ORDERS_DETECTED: Some orders have a zero amount.
INVALID_DURATION: Renewal period must be 1, 3, 6 or 12 months
PLAN_CHANGE_ONLY_AT_NEW_PERIOD: The plan can only be changed in a new period
DOWNGRADE_ONLY_AT_NEW_PERIOD: A downgrade is only possible in a new period
PRODUCT_SHARED_FIELDS_MERCHANT_ONLY: Staff cannot change the name, prices, photos, category or other shared details of a product; ask the shop owner, the branch manager or the warehouse staff. You can update your branch's stock.
PRODUCT_DELETE_MERCHANT_ONLY: Staff cannot delete products; ask the shop owner, the branch manager or the warehouse staff.
OUTLET_HAS_OPEN_ORDERS: This branch still has orders that are reserved or being rented. Complete or cancel them before turning the branch off.
OUTLET_DEACTIVATED: This branch has been deactivated. Please contact the shop owner.
PRODUCT_HELD_BY_OTHER_OUTLETS: {outlets} still has this product; only the shop owner can delete it. To stop selling it at your branch, set your stock to 0.
MODULE_NOT_ENABLED: This feature is not turned on for your shop.
QR_EXPIRED: This QR code is no longer valid. Scan the code shown at the counter today.
QR_WRONG_OUTLET: This QR code belongs to another branch.
OUT_OF_RANGE: You are too far from the branch. Move closer and try again.
GPS_INACCURATE: Your location is not accurate enough. Move near a door or window and try again.
MOCK_LOCATION: A fake location was detected. Turn off the location spoofing app and try again.
ATTENDANCE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Attendance is not set up for this branch yet (location or QR code missing).
ATTENDANCE_LOCATION_NOT_SET: This branch has no attendance location yet, so the distance cannot be checked. Ask the shop owner to set it in Attendance › QR & location.
SHIFT_OVERLAP: This shift overlaps another shift of the same employee.
SHIFT_LOCKED: Past days and days already worked cannot be changed.
SHIFT_LOCKED_NAMED: {names} already clocked in today, so today's shift cannot change. Start from tomorrow.
ATTENDANCE_NOT_REQUIRED: This person is not set to clock in. Turn it on in Attendance › QR & location › Who must clock in.
ATTENDANCE_NOT_REQUIRED_NAMED: {names}: not set to clock in. Turn it on in Attendance › QR & location › Who must clock in first.
SHIFT_TEMPLATE_IN_USE: This shift is in use. Hide it instead of deleting it.
MONTH_LOCKED: This month is locked. Ask the shop owner to unlock it.
RATING_ALREADY_REQUESTED: A rating prompt was already sent.
RATING_REQUEST_FAILED: Could not show the rating prompt. Please try again.
INVALID_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT: The deposit must be zero or more.
DEPOSIT_MANUALLY_OVERRIDDEN: The deposit was entered by hand.
DEPOSIT_AUTO_CALCULATED: The deposit was calculated from the products.
CANNOT_EDIT_DEPOSIT_AFTER_ORDER_CREATED: The deposit cannot be changed after the order is created.
DEPOSIT_EDIT_FAILED: Could not save the deposit. Please try again.
BOOKING_DISABLED: This shop does not take online booking requests.
BOOKING_OUTLET_UNAVAILABLE: This branch does not take online booking requests.
BOOKING_NOT_AVAILABLE: This item is not free on one of the chosen days. Pick other days or a smaller quantity.
BOOKING_RATE_LIMITED: Too many booking requests. Please wait a while and try again, or call the shop.
BOOKING_REQUEST_CLOSED: This booking request was already confirmed, rejected or has expired.
INVALID_PHONE: Please enter a valid phone number.
BOOKING_REQUEST_CREATED: Booking request sent. The shop will confirm it soon.
BOOKING_REQUEST_PREPARED: Booking request ready to create the order.
BLOCK_PRICE_MISMATCH: The price of a day-block item does not match the price list. Reload the product and try again.
PRICING_TYPE_REQUIRES_UPDATE: This product uses day-block pricing. Please update the app to place this rental.
BLOCK_TABLE_INVALID: The day-block price list is not valid. Use 1 to 31 days, prices of 0 or more, and one block price list per product.
INSTALLMENT_EXCEEDS_TOTAL: The deposit stages add up to more than the order total.
INSTALLMENT_OVERPAID: This amount is more than the stage allows, or the new total is lower than what was already collected.
INSTALLMENT_ALREADY_PAID: This deposit stage was already collected.
INSTALLMENT_FORBIDDEN_ROLE: Your role cannot do this with deposit stages.
INSTALLMENT_UNPAID_AT_PICKUP: This order still has a deposit stage that was not collected. Collect it on the web or update the app.
INSTALLMENT_NO_PLAN: This order has no deposit plan.
INSTALLMENT_LOYALTY_UNSUPPORTED: Loyalty points cannot be used on an order with staged deposits.
DEPOSIT_SETTINGS_INVALID: The deposit settings are not valid. Use 1 to 3 stages per template, percentages that add up to 100 or less, and at most 10 templates.
CANCEL_AMOUNTS_MISMATCH: The amount kept is more than what was collected, or is not a valid amount.
CANCELLED_ORDER_KEEPS_AMOUNT: A cancelled order that kept money stays in the history and cannot be deleted.
